name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Image and delayed fallback wrapper built on reka-ui, in sm, md and lg sizes with circle or square shape.
docs: Render AvatarImage and AvatarFallback inside Avatar. AvatarFallback stays visible while loading or when an image fails; pass delayMs to delay the fallback on fast connections.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AvatarRoot } from 'reka-ui'
import { avatarVariants, type AvatarShape, type AvatarSize } from './variants'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AvatarProps = {
  size?: AvatarSize
  shape?: AvatarShape
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AvatarProps>(), {
  size: 'md',
  shape: 'circle',
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AvatarRoot
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(avatarVariants({ size, shape }), attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AvatarRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AvatarImage } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AvatarImageProps = {
  src: string
  alt?: string
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AvatarImageProps>(), {
  alt: '',
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AvatarImage
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :src="src"
    :alt="alt"
    :class="cn('aspect-square size-full object-cover', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AvatarFallback } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AvatarFallbackProps = {
  delayMs?: number
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AvatarFallbackProps>(), {
  delayMs: undefined,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AvatarFallback
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :delay-ms="delayMs"
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex size-full items-center justify-center bg-control font-medium text-ink-muted',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </AvatarFallback>
</template>

export { default as Avatar } from './Avatar.vue'
export { default as AvatarImage } from './AvatarImage.vue'
export { default as AvatarFallback } from './AvatarFallback.vue'
export { avatarVariants } from './variants'

export type { AvatarShape, AvatarSize } from './variants'
export type { AvatarProps } from './Avatar.vue'
export type { AvatarImageProps } from './AvatarImage.vue'
export type { AvatarFallbackProps } from './AvatarFallback.vue'
